title: Nvidia Pauses AI Server Shipments to Four Southeast Asian Countries
summary: Nvidia has reportedly asked major manufacturing partners to pause AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. Dell and Supermicro, which assemble Nvidia chips into complete servers, have told buyers in the four countries that affected orders cannot leave the factory, according to the report. The freeze is linked to a new round of U.S. export controls, though it is unclear whether the measure is temporary; the rules reportedly require regional cloud providers to obtain export licenses within 90 days and verify that customers do not include restricted Chinese entities.
